sn6.11:1.2: ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Sappinī-tīre || || 2.
sn6.11:1.3: Atha kho brahmā Sanaṃkumāro abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ Sappinī-tīram obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || 3.
sn6.11:1.4: Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho brahmā Sanaṃkumāro Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn6.11:3.3: Atha kho brahmā Sanaṃkumāro samanuñño me satthā ti Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth-ev-antaradhāyīti || || 1.
